value: In Old Hollywood, Agatha stars in Howard Stark's Cosmic Queen while plotting to drain Tiamut, the Celestial buried in Earth, and after she takes its power and defeats Arishem, Kingo talks her into giving it up.
verdicts.why: Real error: Agatha carries out the ritual, becomes a Celestial and defeats Arishem before Kingo convinces her to give the power up. Fix merged into one sentence per the text rule.

value: Kamala, Kate and Riri set out from New York across a ruined Earth while Wanda rules the dead, and only Kamala makes it to the North Institute in Ohio, where she meets Melina, Alexei and Yelena.
verdicts.why: Real error: Yelena is not in the travelling group; Danvers kills Kate, Riri sacrifices herself, and Blade brings Kamala to Ohio where Melina, Alexei and Yelena are. Amended because Melina leads that group and later episodes hint the real Riri is still out there, so 'only Kamala lives' overstates.

value: The Watcher takes Peggy from a mission aboard the Lemurian Star into the Guardians of the Multiverse, and back home she and Natasha find the Hydra Stomper armor with someone inside.

value: Strange Supreme helps the Watcher gather the Guardians of the Multiverse, then keeps watch in his own ruined universe over Killmonger and Zola, sealed in a pocket dimension.

value.happens_at: A separate reality: the universe of an Ultron variant who never heard the Watcher (the MCU wiki's 'Reflective Infinity Ultron' universe), not the #8 world whose Ultron Zola destroyed in #9. Move the entry to its own place (e.g. 'Another Ultron's world', Another reality).
